recommendation: Support medication access for hypertension patients
implementation_steps: Synchronize medication refills to improve adherence
Provide refill reminders through automated systems or direct contact
Monitor adherence through refill history analysis
Support pharmacists in medication management activities
Help patients navigate insurance and medication assistance programs
evidence_summary: Pharmacy technician interventions supporting medication access have been shown to improve medication adherence and continuity of therapy for patients with hypertension, particularly when integrated into comprehensive pharmacy-based hypertension management programs.
citation: Implementation Strategies to Improve Blood Pressure Control in the United States
